Pokémon artwork is bundled for offline use from the Pokémon Showdown client assets:

- https://play.pokemonshowdown.com/sprites/pokemonicons-sheet.png
- https://play.pokemonshowdown.com/sprites/gen5/
- https://play.pokemonshowdown.com/sprites/gen5-back/

The official client sprite, animation, FX, cry and music assets are bundled locally. See ASSET-NOTICES.txt and asset-manifest.json for the full resource provenance and upstream per-file notices.

Pokémon and Pokémon character names are trademarks of Nintendo, Game Freak, and Creatures. Sprite artwork belongs to its respective creators; Pokémon Showdown sprite credits: https://play.pokemonshowdown.com/sprites/credits.
